hooks.name: DeadBolt — Invariant Audit on Save
hooks.description: Runs cryptographic property tests and state machine unit tests whenever src/crypto.py, src/vault.py, or src/cli.py is saved. Enforces the Zero Early Release invariant and all Shamir/AES-GCM correctness properties. Exit 2 blocks the save action on failure.

action.command:
python3 -m pytest tests/test_invariants.py tests/test_crypto.py tests/test_vault.py -x -q --tb=short --no-header 2>&1; EXIT=$?; if [ $EXIT -eq 0 ]; then printf '
✅ DeadBolt invariant audit PASSED
'; else printf '
❌ DeadBolt invariant audit FAILED — Zero Early Release invariant may be broken
'; fi; exit $EXIT
